# Gevurah — Sidebar Ownership Boundaries

The Awtsmoos has no boundary, yet each stylesheet must guard one shore;
Awtsmoos.com becomes easier to extend when no selector fights another anymore.

## Winning ownership graph

### Sidebar manifest

`ideal/reborn/sidebar.css` becomes import-only and owns no declarations.

It imports, in order:

1. `sidebar/shell.css` — fixed/open/hidden shell geometry and safe areas.
2. `sidebar/chrome.css` — title row, close/fullscreen/back controls, and interaction states.
3. `sidebar/breadcrumbs.css` — breadcrumb flow and states.
4. `sidebar/containment.css` — local box sizing, overflow containment, placeholders, and tabs.
5. `sidebar/responsive.css` — mobile/desktop size transitions only.

### Panel manifest

`ideal/reborn/panels.css` becomes import-only.

It imports:

1. `panels/viewport.css` — slide viewport/view visibility and transition model.
2. `panels/content.css` — content scrolling, headings, grids, panel flow.
3. `panels/responsive.css` — narrow-screen panel layout.

### Correction manifest

`live-mobile-corrections.css` becomes an import-only compatibility manifest rather than a 343-line dumping ground.

Its rules move to focused domains:

- `corrections/inline-shell.css`
- `corrections/comment-card.css`
- `corrections/comment-composer.css`
- `corrections/details.css`
- `corrections/mobile-layout.css`

Sidebar/chrome/panel/context-menu rules do not remain there; their canonical owners absorb them.

### Context menu

`context-menu.css` remains canonical but becomes locally rooted and uses `--z-modal`. Width uses `dvi`, not `vw`. It owns both `#custom-context-menu` and `#insane-verse-menu` where both are real reader action sheets.

### Fullscreen

`sidebar-fullscreen.css` remains focused but uses `100dvi` and a reader-local derived modal layer instead of literal integers.

### Beauty layer

Commentary beauty selectors are rewritten under the reader root. Beauty decorates; it does not own layout geometry.
